# GitHub Copilot instructions

The rules for this repository live in **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)**. Read that
file before writing or changing any code, and run `python scripts/preflight.py`
before reporting that you are done.

This file exists because Copilot Chat on github.com reads
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` and does not read `AGENTS.md`. Keep it as a
pointer: one source of truth, two file paths.
